excavation_context.character_description: Adult male grad student museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a crisp white lab coat, blue jean slacks, and black dress shoes. Wears signature thin-rimmed black rectangular lens glasses.
excavation_context.stage: Extracting Fossil with Delicate Lab Chisels

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1 is positioned over a laboratory preparation cradle, using a fine micro-chisel and a tiny mallet on a dense sheet of charcoal black shale. He is painstakingly working the marine matrix material surrounding the fossil to lift a massive, curved Baryonyx thumb claw away from embedded prehistoric fish scales. Stark studio lighting reflecting off his black rectangular glasses. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
